title: org.siontology.ledger handler config
description: The config of the ACP payment handler org.siontology.ledger: where and how a checkout session is paid in USD on a Siontology chain.

network.description: The chain as CAIP-2: sion: and the first 16 bytes of its identity in hex.

chain.description: The chain's full identity; a buyer compares it with the one it pinned.

micros_per_cent.description: Siontology amounts are micro-USD; ACP's minor unit for USD is the cent.

requirements.description: An x402 version 2 payment requirement (scheme exact) for the session's total, with a fresh nonce: what the signed transaction must pay.

amount.description: Micro-USD: the session's total in cents times 10000.

extra.description: chain, decimals, nonce, and purpose (what a charter payment must give).
